title: Yellowed Crisp Korean Hake Bibimbap
description: A roasted, crisp, and comforting Korean dish featuring hake, served in a hot stone plate, low in glycemic index and rich in nutrients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the hake fillets with korean chili flakes and let them sit for 10 minutes.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and sear the hake fillets until crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the hake fillets to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 8 minutes or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and rice vinegar.
In a separate pan, stir fry the zucchini and carrots over medium heat until they are tender.
To assemble the bibimbap, place a scoop of cooked brown rice in the bottom of a hot stone plate.
Add a piece of the roasted hake on top of the rice, followed by a spoonful of the stir fried vegetables.
Drizzle the soy sauce and rice vinegar mixture over the top and garnish with chopped green onions and a fried egg if desired.
